propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of reachable .bridge_state history cannot be reclaimed by repack/gc alone and requires a length-aware git fast-export/filter/fast-import history strip followed by separate operator-controlled repack and prune.
The tickets-store filtered pack must drop from 131431 KiB below the 131072 KiB CI gate limit to unblock Gerrit landings on stale-based changes.

A coordinated quiet-window maintenance window must execute prerequisite ticket 30d3 repair first to clean the authoritative store, then perform the history rewrite and compaction with verified off-repo bundles and exact force-with-lease publication.

Post-rewrite identity verification requires that the normalized (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multiset remains identical and that rewritten commits have the same tree/count/merge-count as the original, with old-tip ancestry false after publication.

The deterministic first post-rewrite write must be isolated with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled and must be the sole writer-produced canonical sequence (exactly CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, and bidirectional code-review/work links) within the measurement interval.
